dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: She's getting away! Shouldn't we go after her? \n

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: This place is unstable. It is too risky to continue pursuing her. \n

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: If the place collapsed, the consequences would be disastrous... Let's head back.
